name: IMDb Provider
description: Official IMDb provider (minimal). OMDb when api_key set; else IMDb suggestion fallback + tt id normalize. Secrets in plugin config/env only — never in this manifest or core.

permissions.reason: Receive metadata.provider.query lookups with recognition-layer context; contribute whitelist fields via sync response.

configSchema.label: OMDb API key
configSchema.helpText: OMDb API key (https://www.omdbapi.com). Optional; without it, suggestion fallback is used.

configSchema.label: Data source
configSchema.helpText: omdb (default when key set) or suggest
